message.content: Hailey Johnson offers a variety of services to Li Hua, primarily focusing on baked goods and home delivery. From the conversations shared, Hailey Johnson provides freshly baked sourdough loaves, honey oat bread, and rosemary focaccia. She also includes a bottle of milk as a thank you for being a new customer. In addition to these baked goods, Hailey Johnson offers delivery services, bringing her freshly baked products directly to Li Hua's doorstep. Li Hua expresses appreciation for these offerings, particularly the sourdough bread, which has become a local favorite.
